description: Per-partner plume-dose sensitivity assay on the AERO-SPLIT-01 droplet-partition architecture, opened by PARTNER-RATE-V1's measured canary: at activity_contacts.rates_per_hour x0.25 all 20 takeoff seeds still recorded 1,275-3,525 onsets (median ~3,474, inside the shipped-rate band ~3,470-3,520 vs the record's 197) -- the proximity ring is dose-saturated, not reach-limited, so the partner rate does not bind the ~18x conditional gap. The design's own declared counterfactual named the next suspects: per-partner plume dose or the ring definition. This assay maps the response of the conditional gap to BOTH. Axis verification before freezing (this session's code read, engines/transmission_core.py): under partition the ring dose is _near_field_droplet_dose's partition branch -- near_share * emitted / near_field_flushed_volume_m3_per_epoch -- and flushed volume = near_field_air.interzonal_airflow_m3_per_hour * hours_per_epoch (lines 1912-1915, 4036-4038), so per-partner plume dose scales exactly as 1/beta and transmission_overrides.near_field_air lands the whole block (covid_boarding_screen._apply_transmission_overrides). The ring-definition probe uses the only expressible instrument without a new engine key: per-activity rates_per_hour knockouts, which zero the sampled proximity ring for that activity's zones (poisson mean 0 -> no partners drawn; _activity_contact_draw returns 0) while the fixed rings (cabin-mate, meal-table, adjacent-table weights in _near_field_unit) persist. Cell shape is verbatim from covid_theta_screen_v11_stage2 / covid_partner_rate_assay_v1: onset_day -1.0, departure_day 5.0, dwell_weighted sanitary visits, imports 1, infection_age_days 3.3, the same 20 seeds at base 20200205, full 32-day voyage, droplet_field_split partition.
supersedes: nothing: it extends PARTNER-RATE-V1's measured negative on the reach axis to the dose axis the counterfactual named
prerequisites: PARTNER-RATE-V1 canary measured (37dc215, Batch job-def rev 19): R1_rate_0p25, 20/20 seeds -- conditional recorded mass q05 2,457 / median 3,474 / q95 3,518 vs the record's 197; the partner-rate axis does not bind the conditional gap; the ring is dose-saturated (docs/ledger/PARTNER-RATE-V1.md, docs/covid/covid_partner_rate_assay_v1_readout.md).

AERO-SPLIT-01 measured (e20008d): droplet_field_split partition is the shipped default; the near share reaches the partner-bounded proximity ring at plume concentration; the takeoff-seed day-0-2 spike persists at the shipped rate.

Axis binding verified in the tree before freeze: under partition, _near_field_droplet_dose(zone, target, emitted, volume, ..., near_share=droplet_field_split.near_field_share) uses gain = near_share / max(near_field_flushed_volume_m3_per_epoch, 1.0), and near_field_flushed_volume_m3_per_epoch = near_field_air.interzonal_airflow_m3_per_hour * clock.hours_per_epoch -- single consumer, so scaling beta scales per-partner plume dose and nothing else on the partition path. The shipped config declares no near_field_air block, so the code defaults apply: mode two_box, interzonal_airflow_m3_per_hour 204.0 (Keil 2017 GM, Grade B), neighbour_table_ratio 0.43 (Li 2021, Grade B).

Knockout binding verified in the tree: _activity_contact_draw returns 0 partners when the activity's rate is 0 (mean <= 0 short-circuits the poisson draw), and _proximity_shedder_ids samples nothing when no shedder is drawn -- a zeroed activity removes its sampled ring while _near_field_unit's fixed rings (cabin-mate in Cabin_Corridor, same-table, adjacent-table at rho) are untouched.
thetas_note: Single point: the fleet-admissible Theta the stage-2 replay runs at, verbatim from PARTNER-RATE-V1. This is an arm assay at fixed Theta, not a Theta screen.
infection_age_note: Verbatim from v10/stage-2/v1/partner-rate: NOT an axis -- under the declared onset_day -1.0 the infection age cancels exactly; 3.3 is carried so cell keys and run specs match the prior rows exactly.
seeds_note: Verbatim: the SAME 20 matched seeds at the same base, so every cell pairs seed-for-seed with the stage-2 surface, the v1 assay rows, and the PARTNER-RATE-V1 canary row.
cells_note: 10 arms x 1 axis point x 20 seeds = 200 cells, each a full 768-epoch (32-day) voyage (~30 min). Arm-major enumeration puts D0_declared at cells 0-19, the dose-down arms ascending at 20-99, the knockout arms at 100-179, and W_pool_witness at 180-199.

cell_payload_additions.note: Unchanged from v1/partner-rate: the same worker fields plus the arm-attribution block, so the dose surface reads beside the rate surface and the route attribution can separate droplet-ring from direct-contact movement on the knockout arms.
cell_payload_additions.index_onset_day: Must equal -1.0 in every cell; a deviation is a seeding-path defect that invalidates the cell.
cell_payload_additions.index_shedding_at_day0: True by construction: the seeded host is one day past onset at boarding.
cell_payload_additions.index_departed_epoch: The epoch the seeded host left the ship, echoed for audit.
cell_payload_additions.infections_total: Truth-channel count of hosts ever infected, index excluded.
cell_payload_additions.vsp_reported_case_fraction_max: Recorded, not thresholded, as in v1.
cell_payload_additions.quarantine_attribution: during_quarantine_by_route -- the per-route event split that lets the readout say whether a moved conditional mass moved on the droplet ring or the direct-contact path.

arms.note: The declared replay under the shipped partition at shipped beta 204 (dose multiplier 1.00). The dose curve's anchor; first arm, so empty overrides per the arm grammar.

Per-partner plume dose x0.05 (beta x20, 4080 m3/h) -- the deep-cut end of the dose sweep and the canary row (INDEX_OFFSET 20): it proves the override lands AND answers the declared counterfactual 'if even 0.05x dose over-produces, dose concentration is not the binder either; the ring's structure or the observational channel is next'. Physically a mechanism probe, not a parameter proposal: a 4,080 m3/h breathing-zone flush is implausible -- declared as such, never fitted.
Per-partner plume dose x0.10 (beta 2,040 m3/h) -- mechanism probe, physically implausible as a breathing-zone airflow; declared as a dose-axis point, never a candidate value.

Sampled-ring knockout: no proximity partners drawn for dining_table or dining_venue activity (Meal token or Dining zones) -- the meal venues that carry the day-0-2 spike. Fixed rings (same-table party, adjacent-table rho) are untouched, so this isolates the SAMPLED ring's contribution at meals; the shared-table confound applies (direct-contact partners for the same activity are also zeroed -- route attribution separates the channels).
Sampled-ring knockout while working (Work token: service duty or other) -- the crew-work channels. Shared-table confound applies.

Sampled-ring knockout in cabins (Sleep/own stateroom) and hallways -- the private-space partners. The fixed cabin-mate ring persists (Cabin_Corridor weight 1.0 is geometry, not the sampled draw), so this reads the sampled cabin/corridor partners only. Shared-table confound applies.
Sampled-ring knockout on Free token (promenade/leisure zones) -- the other half of the public-zone spike alongside dining. Shared-table confound applies.

The labelled pre-change baseline: the pool carries the whole continuous share and no proximity draw exists -- the pool-era engine on current main with shipped beta. Execution witness against the pre-partition stage-2 row (~3,470-3,520 conditional recorded onsets on takeoff seeds); any drift from it is an engine regression since 8cda4c7, not physics. D0 minus W is the partition's measured effect at the shipped constants.

arms_note: Dose arms declare the complete near_field_air block because transmission_overrides replaces it wholesale; shipped config declares none, so defaults are restated explicitly (mode two_box, neighbour_table_ratio 0.43) with only interzonal_airflow_m3_per_hour moving. Dose multiplier m maps to beta = 204/m since the partition-form dose is linear in 1/beta. Knockout arms declare the complete activity_contacts block with the named activities zeroed and the rest at shipped CONTACT-ARCH-01 rates; 'other' stays 0.0. A literal ring redefinition (partner cap, contact window) needs a new engine key and is deliberately out of scope -- the knockouts are the ring-definition probe the existing grammar can express.

scoring.statement: Stage-2 conditional clause family, scored per arm and as a dose response curve plus a knockout table. FROZEN before any assay cell exists; nothing is loosened and nothing is tightened.

conditional_trajectory_clause.criterion: Per arm, scored only among takeoff seeds (recorded_onsets >= takeoff_recorded_onsets = 10): the takeoff seeds' q05-q95 interval of recorded_onsets contains 197 AND the takeoff seeds' median before_share is within 0.10 of 0.173 (34/197 onsets before day 17, 6 February). The clause is scored only when an arm has >= 5 takeoff seeds; below that it is reported as 'insufficient takeoff mass', not failed.
conditional_trajectory_clause.note: Verbatim clause family from v11/v11-stage-2/v1/partner-rate, restricted to each arm's own takeoff class. Reported beside it, never thresholded: the fraction of TAKEOFF seeds whose recorded_onsets lies in [98.5, 394] and the full per-seed recorded_onsets vector per arm.

declared: dose_binding: the takeoff-seed conditional recorded mass (q05-q95 and median) as a function of dose multiplier on {0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 1.00} -- monotone non-increasing in dose means the per-partner plume dose binds the conditional gap.
linearity_elasticity: the log-log slope of the conditional median vs dose multiplier between 0.05 and 1.00 -- a declared read, not a fit; a flat slope says the mass is dose-insensitive at this grid.

elbow: whether ANY dose multiplier's takeoff-seed q05-q95 contains 197 (a report-immediately trigger), and if so the largest dose multiplier that still contains it -- the dose-only closure scale; never a beta selection.
collapse_point: the lowest dose multiplier whose arm still clears the takeoff gate (>= 5/20 takeoff seeds) -- the dose scale at which the ring stops sustaining takeoff, if the grid reaches it.

knockout_table: each K arm's conditional mass and takeoff fraction versus D0_declared -- names which activity's sampled ring carries the mass; a knockout that collapses takeoff names the binding venue class.
witness_delta: D0_declared vs W_pool_witness at shipped constants -- the partition's measured effect, set against the paired probe and the PARTNER-RATE-V1 canary.
response_curve_reads.declared_counterfactual: Both directions frozen in advance. If even D1 (dose x0.05) over-produces -- its takeoff-seed q05-q95 excludes 197 upward -- then plume dose concentration is not the binding constraint either: the suspect moves to the ring's structure beyond per-activity composition (the fixed cabin-mate/table rings, the seeded index's day-0 exposure geometry) or the observational channel -- the knockout table says which sampled venue still carries the mass. If a dose-down arm collapses takeoff or contains 197, dose IS load-bearing and the curve locates the dose scale the record's number lives at -- reported as a map of response, never a tuned beta.
response_curve_reads.declared_expectation: PARTNER-RATE-V1 measured near-certainty per partner draw, so the expected result is the dose curve bending somewhere on the 0.05-0.50 range -- an elastic slope identifying where ring infections stop being near-certain. A flat curve through 0.05 is equally a valid result: it would clear dose and leave ring structure and the observational channel as the standing suspects.

index_geometry.criterion: AUDIT INVARIANT, verbatim from v10/v11/v1/partner-rate: index_onset_day == -1.0 and index_shedding_at_day0 true in 100% of every cell's seeds; a deviation is a seeding-path defect that invalidates the cell rather than excluding it from selection.
index_geometry.reads: the seeded host's own onset and shedding record

per_arm.closes_the_gap: arm's takeoff-seed q05-q95 contains 197 AND conditional median in [98.5, 394] AND takeoff mass >= 5/20 -- that dose scale or knockout could close the conditional gap (report immediately).
per_arm.load_bearing: q05-q95 excludes 197 but the arm's conditional median falls >= 50% versus D0_declared's conditional median.
per_arm.takeoff_collapse: fewer than 5/20 takeoff seeds -- the arm produces a voyage class that cannot take off; reported as collapse, not scored on the clause.

curve_level.dose_closes: some dose multiplier's arm satisfies closes_the_gap -- plume dose is a candidate closure mechanism at that scale.
curve_level.dose_bound_but_short: conditional mass is monotone and the elastic slope is steep, but the low end still over-produces -- dose is load-bearing and insufficient; the knockouts then name the venue that survives.
curve_level.dose_inert: the curve is flat through x0.05 -- plume dose does not bind; suspect the ring's fixed-structure (cabin-mate/table rings) or the observational channel directly.

scoring.rng_pairing_caveat: Declared from stochastic-attribution: beta changes no draw (the flushed volume is a constant divisor, not an RNG consumer), so dose-arm RNG streams are structurally identical until an infection outcome flips -- after which trajectories diverge. Knockout arms reorder the contact-draw stream like the rate sweep did. All reads are distribution-level (20-seed q05-q95 per arm), never seed-paired; the mode-off witness draws nothing on the proximity path and is not pairable either.
scoring.note: The clause gates nothing -- there is no Theta to admit. The assay's product is the dose response curve plus the knockout table: per-arm conditional reads, the curve-level verdict, and the declared counterfactual's answer in whichever direction it lands.

what_this_cannot_settle: It does not pick a beta -- the sweep maps the response surface; choosing a plume-flush constant is a provenance question (the shipped 204 m3/h is Keil 2017 GM, Grade B), not this assay's.

The dose arms are mechanism probes at the low end: beta 816-4,080 m3/h is physically implausible as a breathing-zone airflow. A dose-down closure does not license shipping the arm's beta -- it says the dose scale binds, and the honest constant must come from source, not from the grid.

The knockouts share the activity_contacts table with the direct-contact path (CONTACT-ARCH-01 by construction): zeroing an activity removes both the sampled ring and its direct-contact partners. Route attribution in the payload separates which channel's event share moved, but the design cannot sweep the droplet ring alone.

The knockouts do not touch the fixed rings: cabin-mate (Cabin_Corridor weight 1.0), same-meal-table (1.0) and adjacent-table (rho) weights in _near_field_unit exist independently of the sampled ring -- a fully-overproducing knockouts row would place the residual there, which is a declared answer, not an ambiguity.
It does not re-ask far_field_share (declared separately) or the partner rate (measured negative by PARTNER-RATE-V1).

W_pool_witness equality with the pre-partition stage-2 row asserts current-main mode-off equals the pre-change engine; a drift there is an execution regression since 8cda4c7, not physics, and is reported as such.

execution.platform: AWS Batch EC2 Spot, per .agents/skills/aws-batch-campaign/SKILL.md, via deploy/aws/submit_covid_boarding_screen.sh with DESIGN=covid_plume_dose_assay_v1. The image must be built from a main that contains this design file: the design is read inside the container. Job definition revision and image digest pinned per campaign-preflight step 3, never a bare tag.
execution.canary: D1_dose_0p05 (dose multiplier 0.05), all 20 seeds -- array 20 at INDEX_OFFSET 20 (arm-major enumeration puts this row at cell indices 20-39), inspected before any further submission: every cell's spec carried the overridden near_field_air block (the override landed, not spec-only), the engine read back beta 4080, the payload contract is intact, the arm is not degenerate, and the index-geometry audit invariant holds. Then STOP and report -- the user decides whether the full array runs. Canary cells are skipped idempotently by _already_complete when the array is submitted.
execution.report_immediately_if: the canary row is read out (stop after it -- the user decides the array); any arm's takeoff-seed conditional q05-q95 contains 197; any arm collapses takeoff below ~5/20 (the collapse point is itself a declared read); the dose override does not bind at runtime (engine reads back beta 204 on a dose arm -- spec-lands but inert is a bug signature, not physics); any cell's audit invariant fails (index_onset_day != -1.0 or index_shedding_at_day0 false); or the child failure rate exceeds 5%.
